outcome: Relative contribution of each Robson group to overall CS rate
cohort: The study included 1464 deliveries, encompassing 507 cesarean sections, from the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Holy Family Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan.
finding: The overall CS rate was identified, with Group 5, Group 2, and Group 10 being the major contributors to cesarean deliveries, and previous CS, non-progress of labor, and cephalopelvic disproportion as the leading indications.
mod_finding: The audit found that 48.8% of CSs were elective and 51.2% were emergency, with Group 5 (previous CS) being the largest contributor to the overall CS rate, highlighting the need to promote vaginal birth after cesarean.
cross-section timing: Hospital delivery records from January 1st to December 31st, 2022
